description: Aangemelde private laadpunten voor elektrische voertuigen is a dataset listed in Fluvius open data portal, an open data portal of a distribution network operator, published or maintained by Fluvius (Flanders). Deze dataset bevat alle aangemelde private laadpunten voor elektrische voertuigen. Per installatie vind je het jaar van indienstname, het vermogen, op welk spanningsniveau het laadpunt is aangesloten en de postcode. Disclaimer: Fluvius spant zich in om volledige en actuele informatie aan te bieden. Coverage: Belgium (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Energietransitie: adoptie van nieuwe technologieën. Its keywords are Laadpunt, Elektriciteit. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open data license - FLUVIUS (https://opendata.fluvius.be/p/licentieopendatafluvius). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fluvius-open-data-portal.
